note: Based on the original description of the new species by Emerson (1925) (in English); the original placed it under the subgenus Nasutitermes (Subulitermes), and it was later transferred to Atlantitermes; both the alate and the soldier are fully described. The author noted that the species is close to the “Constrictotermes” flaveolus described by Banks (1919), but is smaller and has hairs along the whole length of the nasus. The species name honours T. E. Snyder.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown, oval; covered with hairs and a few setae. Fontanelle aperture slit-like, forked at the tip. Antennae darker, 14-segmented, segment 2 slightly larger than segment 3, segment 3 about equal to segment 4. Eyes rather large and prominent, close to the lower margin of the head. Ocelli relatively rather large, separated from the eyes by less than one third of their diameter. Labrum pale. Postclypeus almost as dark as the head. Pronotum almost as dark as the head, posterior margin not concave, lateral margins and angles rounded. Posterior margins of meso- and metanotum broadly concave. Wings dark smoky, with a pale stripe between the media and the cubitus. Abdominal tergites about as dark as the pronotum.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, oval in dorsal view, with a very slight constriction behind the antennal bases; the lateral profile from the base of the nasus to the vertex is broadly convex, with a slight depression in the middle; covered with short hairs, with a few longer setae at the base of the nasus and on the vertex. Antennae 11-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 about equal. Mandibles without points. Nasus brownish yellow, straight and slender, covered with microscopic hairs. Abdomen coloured like the gut contents; abdominal tergites with a row of setae on the posterior margin and covered with fairly long hairs.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Alate measurements (mm): length including wings 7.00—8.00; length excluding wings 3.50—4.50; head length 0.76—0.80; head width 0.67—0.70; antennal length 1.33; eye diameter 0.23; pronotum length 0.37—0.40, width 0.50—0.53; hind tibia length 0.83; forewing length 6.56, width 1.83. Soldier measurements (mm): body length 2.50—2.80; head length 0.90—0.93; head width 0.40—0.43; antennal length 0.83—0.87; pronotum width 0.30; hind tibia length 0.50—0.53. Type locality: Kartabo, British Guiana.
